mentions.name: Recap360
mentions.description: A macOS-only video player focused on 360-degree videos. It supports GoPro MAX, DJI Osmo 360 and Insta360 cameras, and also plays dash cams and body cams (Vantrue and Boblov). It loads footage of a multi-hour ride in seconds directly from MicroSD as a small ~5MB download with no ads and no accounts, and shows a map overlay plus graphs of internal camera metadata such as speed, altitude, ascent rate and internal temperature.
mentions.problem: Existing 360 camera playback software (GoPro MAX and DJI Osmo 360) was clunky and powerful but still not what the author wanted for reviewing ride videos.
mentions.source_excerpt: As an audio video developer I knew I could make it work the way I wanted, and this year I finally set about doing that:  https://recap360.app  (macOS-only at the moment).
mentions.author: moj
